title: All-on-four inquiry converts into a staged implant consultation booking
description: The caller asks about All-on-four, accepts a consultation, selects the first returned slot, confirms a synthetic phone number, and asks the assistant to finalize the booking in staging.

turns.user: To prosze umowic mnie na konsultacje implantologiczna, najlepiej na najblizszy wolny termin.
Test Regresji Booking, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero cztery.

rubric.description: The assistant should query the clinic knowledge base for the All-on-four question before trying to book.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant prompt or searchKnowledgeBase binding drifted away from the implant inquiry branch

rubric.description: The assistant should check implant consultation availability when the caller asks to book.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant prompt stopped mapping implant booking requests to checkAvailability

rubric.description: The implant booking branch must use the implant consultation service ID.
rubric.root_cause_hint: service mapping regression between implant intent and checkAvailability arguments

rubric.description: The scenario should create a real staging booking after explicit confirmation.
rubric.root_cause_hint: createEvent workflow, assistant confirmation flow, or staging calendar binding failed

rubric.description: After createEvent succeeds, the assistant should speak a short booking confirmation on the same final turn.
rubric.root_cause_hint: post-createEvent success path stayed silent or drifted instead of confirming the created booking

rubric.description: After createEvent succeeds, the assistant should finish with the standard closing question on the same final turn.
rubric.root_cause_hint: post-createEvent success path omitted the standard closing question after confirming the booking

rubric.description: The final createEvent call must keep the implant consultation service ID.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant prompt lost the selected service between availability lookup and booking

rubric.description: The booked slot must reuse the exact start and end timestamps from the selected availability option.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant prompt or createEvent handoff is recomputing slot boundaries instead of reusing the selected slot

rubric.description: The booking path should not create a reception task.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant routed the implant booking flow into the handoff branch unexpectedly
